crop: 32^3 native-axis grid spanning twice each box extent; each-image .5/99.5 percentile normalization
target: source component binary mask, nearest resampling, constrained to original box
model: 3D UNet widths8,16,32, GroupNorm SiLU, trilinear upsampling
loss: 0.5 BCE + 0.5 soft Dice, equal source rows

training.selection: max source development original component binary crop Dice

source_split: same174 train /44 development positive cases as E03; final all218 cases277components4986rows; binary shape flip native first axis on mirror rows
postprocessing: threshold .5; largest26-connected component; if empty use original ellipsoid; output constrained to original candidate box
gpu: GPU2 UUID only for train/infer; CPU prepare/evaluate
limitations: cropped source dev Dice is not native official Dice
center2 is repeatedly used research holdout, all positive; no patient-linkage metadata
